snippet.description:
Anyone who’s ever been to a gas station in the United States knows there’s a pharmacy-level selection of drugs behind the counter. But kratom and its synthetic counterpart, 7-OH, are the subject of controversy because of overdoses and a lack of regulation.

Listen to the full episode of Today, Explained wherever you get your podcasts.
